page.overview:
Who is Ryan Shields?

Ryan Shields races for the team "View Zeen" in the movie Cars. He appears to be a turquoise car with robin's egg blue overlays on the windows and the spoiler, the eye color of sky blue, and the maize number 39.

"Ryan is not only a View Zeen Corrective Windshields driver, he's also a customer. Without it, the race is merely a blur of multi-colored blobs moving at 200 miles per hour. His View Zeen windshield doesn't just help out on the track, it also has a special coating that helps cut down on glare while driving at night, not to mention it makes him look smarter."
